use_when: to describe an item with keywords, such as cozy or mystery.
when an item can have several labels at once.
Use Small tags in tables and lists, and Medium tags in forms and filters.
Turn on Show remove when people can delete the tag, such as an applied filter.

dont_use_when.when: Do not give tags colors. Tags are always neutral.
Do not show more than 3 tags in a table cell.

best_practice: Write tags in lowercase, one or two words.
Use the same word for the same idea everywhere, such as always “cozy”, never “cosy”.
Keep 8px between tags in a row.

variant_intent.size=Small: Figma: tags in tables and lists.
variant_intent.size=Medium: Figma: tags in forms and filters.
variant_intent.showRemove=true: Figma: when people can delete the tag, such as an applied filter.

placement: Keep 8px between tags in a row.

a11y.fact: The remove control is a native <button> labelled "Remove <label>".
The remove button can be disabled natively (removeDisabled).
The remove button shows a focus ring on keyboard focus.
